title_zh: 用具体成果练习面试回答

scenario.goal_zh: 把笼统自我评价改成具体工作例子

context_zh: 米娅请朋友雷练习一段求职面试回答。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.text: I have an interview with a leading design agency, and I want to make a good impression.

sentences.speaker: Ray
sentences.text: How are you planning to describe your work?

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.text: I was going to say that my last project was impressive and that everyone loved it.

sentences.speaker: Ray
sentences.text: That tells them your opinion, but not what you did. What was the problem you solved?

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.text: The old booking form was incredibly confusing. Customers kept calling because they could not find the date selector.

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.text: I moved it to the first page and tested the form with five customers. All five completed it without help.

sentences.speaker: Ray
sentences.text: That is much clearer. You do not need to call yourself highly talented if you can explain your work.

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.text: Right. I will start with the problem, describe my change, and give the test result.

sentences.speaker: Ray
sentences.text: Try that answer once more, and I will listen without interrupting.
